platform_chrome_findings.finding: Main window requests hidden title bar on all three builds. Title-bar overlay is enabled in Linux and Windows and disabled in macOS.

Windows title-bar overlay function uses a transparent #00000000 ordinary overlay background; Linux uses its theme-derived background. Both contain special conditional color branches and light/dark symbol colors.

platform_chrome_findings.finding: macOS main-window control placement is recomputed through its zoom-dependent traffic-light function; Linux and Windows main-window declarations use a fixed function result initialized at zoom 1.

platform_chrome_findings.finding: The shared CDS stylesheet explicitly selects default arrow cursor for desktop interactive controls; legacy shell CSS overrides buttons to pointer cursor. These declarations are common across all three builds.

No installer, application binary, native companion or target JavaScript was run; no login or system settings changed.
